blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — UK digital bank Revolut remains in active talks with Philippine regulators as it seeks a license to enter the country’s digital banking market, potentially adding to competition in the fast-growing sector. Speaking to reporters last week, Lyn Javier, deputy governor at the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), said Revolut remained interested in entering […]...
